items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: We also had Zeke Bradley. ... And they asked me if I would like to play in the band, and so that was a lovely experience to be able to play that music. And they had a very, very good band. I remember some of the guys... Zeke Bradley, a good trumpet player, played with that band.

ctx.x: The leader was Doc Palmer on trumpet. We also had Zeke Bradley. And our lead trumpet was Man(?) Henderson. He only played the lead as long as it took Doc to learn it, because as soon as Doc learned it, he played the lead. Doc didn't read, but he had fantastic ears and fantastic power and fantastic sound on his trumpet. He is one of the great trumpet players. It's too bad that he wasn't recorded. He was really one of the greats during the Louis Armstrong era. A powerful trumpet player. And he could play all the…
They had the one trombone, Butch Rose(?), the trombone player. Then we had Clarence Holliston playing the lead alto, I played the third alto part, and Lucious Stokes played the tenor.
